title: Viakifishi (Theme 1: Usafi wa kibinafsi)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child gives every sentence a capital and an end mark, every proper noun and title-with-name a capital, and abbreviations their capital and full stop.
steps: Capital at the start, mark at the end.
Capitals for names and titles with names.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni sentensi ipi imeandikwa sawa?" Kwa nini "tuliona nairobi jana." si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Sentensi huanza kwa herufi kubwa, na majina ya pekee pia.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Sentensi ya kawaida huisha kwa nini?" Kwa nini "kiulizi" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Sentensi ya kawaida huisha kwa kikomo (.).

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni sentensi ipi ina herufi kubwa isiyofaa?" Kwa nini "Mama alinunua Mkate." si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Herufi kubwa si kwa nomino ya kawaida katikati ya sentensi.

misconceptions.ask: Kifupisho hiki kinasimama badala ya neno gani?
misconceptions.repair: Vifupisho huandikwa kwa herufi kubwa na kikomo: Bw., S.L.P.

checks.question: Andika vizuri: bi. amina anaishi eldoret
